content: I will modify the projection formula in `OntologyLayout.ts` to invert the world Y depth calculation.

args.Description: "Invert world Y component of depth calculation for 3D perspective to create a downward/perspective view."
args.Instruction: "Change worldY * Math.sin(tiltAngle) to -worldY * Math.sin(tiltAngle) in depth calculation"
args.ReplacementContent: "      // 3D X축 회전 변환 공식 적용 (depthH를 활용해 원근 배율 조정)\n      const rotatedY = worldY * Math.cos(tiltAngle) - h * Math.sin(tiltAngle);\n      const depth = -worldY * Math.sin(tiltAngle) + depthH * Math.cos(tiltAngle);"
args.TargetContent: "      // 3D X축 회전 변환 공식 적용 (depthH를 활용해 원근 배율 조정)\n      const rotatedY = worldY * Math.cos(tiltAngle) - h * Math.sin(tiltAngle);\n      const depth = worldY * Math.sin(tiltAngle) + depthH * Math.cos(tiltAngle);"
